name: Ophelia
one_liner: Ophelia offers online Suboxone (buprenorphine) treatment for opioid use disorder by video, in select states, with insurance or $245/month self-pay.
best_for: Adults with opioid use disorder who want buprenorphine treatment from home
People who want to use insurance for Suboxone treatment
People in a supported state who want regular video visits instead of clinic visits
not_for: Anyone in crisis or experiencing an overdose: call 911, or call or text 988
People who need medically supervised detox, intensive outpatient or residential care
People in states where Ophelia doesn't operate
short_description: Online Suboxone treatment for opioid use disorder by video visits with a clinician and care team. Insurance or $245/month self-pay.
long_description: Ophelia is a telehealth practice that treats opioid use disorder with buprenorphine-naloxone (Suboxone). Care is delivered by video visits with licensed clinicians, with ongoing support from a care team. It operates only in select US states. Self-pay is $245 per month for clinician visits, Suboxone management and care-team support, with medication billed separately by the pharmacy; many insurance plans are accepted, including select Medicaid plans. Ophelia has published observational studies of patient retention in its program; no randomized trial of the service was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; $245/month self-pay plus medication
pricing.notes: Self-pay $245/month covers clinician video visits, Suboxone management and care-team support; medication is separate. Accepts many insurance plans including select Medicaid plans. No charge if you decide at the intake visit it isn't a fit.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says Ophelia takes part in interest-based advertising, lets ad networks and social media track site use, and shares hashed emails or user IDs with Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and Google for targeted ads; deletion by deleting your account.

seo.meta_description: Ophelia provides private, online Suboxone treatment for opioid addiction with licensed clinicians and ongoing support, accepting most insurance.

faqs.a: With insurance, copays typically range from $0-50 per visit. Self-pay is approximately $195/month for medication management. Medication costs are separate. Ophelia works with major commercial insurers and Medicare.

Yes, Ophelia provides discreet treatment through a private app. No physical pharmacy visits are required as at-home testing is used. Medical records are protected by HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 substance use privacy rules.

faqs.q: How quickly can I start treatment with Ophelia?
faqs.a: Most patients can schedule their first appointment within days. If clinically appropriate, medication can be prescribed at your first visit. Treatment starts quickly compared to traditional addiction treatment wait times.

faqs.q: What support does Ophelia provide beyond prescriptions?
faqs.a: Ophelia includes a dedicated care team, coaching support, and ongoing clinical monitoring. The app provides tools for tracking progress and connecting with your team. Some plans include therapy access.

availability.note: Online Suboxone treatment in select US states only; check Ophelia's site for your state.

patient_summary: You have an intake video visit with an Ophelia clinician, who can prescribe Suboxone if it is right for you, then continue with regular video visits and support from a care team. You can use insurance (many plans, including select Medicaid plans) or pay $245/month plus the cost of medication; you are not charged if you decide at intake it isn't a fit.
